title: Running Race Predictor
description: Predict race times from a known performance using the Riegel formula.
howto: Select the distance of a recent race (or enter a custom distance).
Enter your finishing time as mm:ss or h:mm:ss.
Optionally enter a custom target distance.
Read predicted times and paces for 5K, 10K, half marathon, marathon, and your custom distance.

faqs.a: Predicted time = known time x (new distance / known distance)^1.06. It is an empirical fit from exercise scientist Peter Riegel.
Reasonably close for trained runners between 5K and marathon. It assumes similar fitness and conditions, and tends to be optimistic for beginners.
